display.purpose: Screen-level H1 titles only, Libre Caslon Text.

headline.purpose: Section H2 titles within a screen.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows and category badges, used sparingly.

icons.purpose: Material Symbols Outlined — fuente de íconos monocroma.

shadows.name: ambient-rest
shadows.purpose: Default resting shadow for cards, buttons, badges.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state on cards and primary buttons, paired with a 1px translate-y lift.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Modals, bottom sheets and FABs floating above the page.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions, modal entrances, fades.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Standard UI transition window; nothing slower except the AI-loading message rotation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button, sage fill, pill shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 24px; background: #5a6e59; color: #FDFAF7; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(44,44,44,0.08); transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4F5F4F; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(44,44,44,0.10); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #3F4B3E; transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5a6e59; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 24px; background: #E8EFE7; color: #5a6e59; border: none; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #dfe8dd; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input with sage-tinted border and focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #2C2C2C; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid rgba(139,158,138,0.25); background: #FDFAF7; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 16px; color: #2C2C2C; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B6B57; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #5a6e59; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(139,158,138,0.15); }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Multi-select filter chip, active and inactive states.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-chip-active { border-color: #5a6e59; background: #5a6e59; color: #FDFAF7; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(44,44,44,0.08); } .ds-chip-inactive { border-color: rgba(139,158,138,0.25); background: #FDFAF7; color: #68685A; } .ds-chip-inactive:hover { border-color: #b8c9b7; background: #E8EFE7; color: #2C2C2C; }

components.name: Wardrobe Card
components.description: Signature ClothingCard: 3:4 photo, floating category badge, secondary CTA.
components.css: .ds-clothing-card { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(139,158,138,0.25); background: #FDFAF7; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(44,44,44,0.08); transition: box-shadow 200ms; width: 220px; } .ds-clothing-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(44,44,44,0.10); } .ds-clothing-photo { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: #E8EFE7; } .ds-clothing-badge { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(253,250,247,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #2C2C2C; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(44,44,44,0.08); } .ds-clothing-cta { display: block; width: 100%; border-radius: 0.5rem; margin-top: 8px; background: #E8EFE7; color: #5a6e59; border: none; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-clothing-cta:hover { background: #5a6e59; color: #FDFAF7; }

components.name: Top App Bar
components.description: Sticky header nav, active/inactive pill links.
components.html:
StrandIA
ArmarioOutfits
components.css: .ds-navbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 24px; background: rgba(253,250,247,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid #d1d5db; } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; color: #2C2C2C; } .ds-nav-link { border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #68685A; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #E8EFE7; color: #2C2C2C; } .ds-nav-link-active { background: #E8EFE7; color: #5a6e59; }

components.name: Bottom Nav
components.description: Fixed mobile-only tab bar, primary navigation on small screens (md:hidden). Three real routes only.
components.css: .ds-bottomnav { position: fixed; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; border-top: 1px solid #d1d5db; background: rgba(253,250,247,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); padding: 8px 8px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); } .ds-bottomnav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #68685A; text-decoration: none; } .ds-bottomnav-icon { display: flex; height: 36px; width: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-bottomnav-item-active .ds-bottomnav-icon { background: #E8EFE7; color: #5a6e59; } .ds-bottomnav-item-active { color: #5a6e59; }

narrative.overview: StrandIA feels like a personal closet photographed for a magazine spread — warm, natural light, sage green and cream paper tones — but disciplined like a well-built product, not a mood board. Libre Caslon Text gives every heading the weight of an editorial pull-quote; Hanken Grotesk carries everything functional with quiet precision. The system exists to make the user's own wardrobe photos the visual protagonist: UI chrome recedes into soft cream and sage so real garment colors and textures read as the highlight of every screen. This system explicitly rejects cold corporate SaaS (no blue-gradient dashboards, no generic flat iconography, no glassmorphism) and rejects fast-fashion urgency (no discount banners, no clashing high-contrast sale colors). It also rejects maximalist fashion-magazine excess — density and ornament stay in check so the product still feels like a clean, fast, trustworthy tool.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral base (cream #FAF0E6 bg, paper #FDFAF7 surfaces) instead of stark white or cold gray.
One committed brand hue — sage green — carrying identity across buttons, active states, and accents.
Serif display type reserved strictly for headings; sans for everything else.
Nearly flat elevation; shadow is a whisper, not a structural device.
Fully rounded (pill) interactive controls — buttons, chips — paired with generous xl radii on content cards.

rules.name: The One Sage Rule
rules.body: Sage is the only saturated color in the system. It never competes with a second accent hue — variety comes from tint (light/mid/hover/active), never from introducing blue, purple, or a second brand color.

rules.name: The Warm-Never-Cold Rule
rules.body: Every neutral in this system — background, surface, border, muted text — carries a warm/olive undertone. A pure gray or pure white anywhere in this system is a bug, not a stylistic choice.

rules.name: The Serif-Never-Body Rule
rules.body: Libre Caslon Text renders headings only. It never appears in body copy, buttons, form fields, or navigation — those are always Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The Shadow-as-Breath Rule
rules.body: Shadow opacity never exceeds 0.14. If a shadow reads as dark or dramatic, it's wrong for this system — depth here is suggested, not staged.

rules.name: The Real-Routes-Only Rule
rules.body: The bottom nav only links to routes that exist and work. A feature that's still a placeholder (like Comunidad) stays a visual card inside a screen, never a bottom nav tab — a global nav slot implies the destination is real.

dos: Do let the user's garment photos be the most saturated, highest-contrast element on any wardrobe screen — UI chrome stays in the cream/sage/paper register around them.
Do use sage as the only saturated brand color; express variety through its tint scale (light/mid/hover/active), not a second hue.
Do keep shadow opacity at or below 0.14 and pair every hover shadow with a 1px translate lift.
Do reserve Libre Caslon Text for headings only; Hanken Grotesk everywhere else.
Do give every interactive element a visible active: state, not just hover:.
Do keep the timing window at 160-240ms for UI transitions; the AI-loading message rotation is the sanctioned exception.
donts: Don't introduce cold corporate SaaS patterns: blue-gradient panels, generic flat dashboard iconography, glassmorphism used decoratively, gradient-filled text.
Don't use fast-fashion / e-commerce urgency cues: discount banners, high-contrast sale badges, countdown-timer aesthetics.
Don't use pure white or cold gray anywhere — every neutral must carry the warm/olive undertone already defined in the palette.
Don't put a placeholder or unshipped feature in the bottom nav — every tab must go to a real, working route.
Don't stack shadows past shadow-lg (0 12px 40px rgba(44,44,44,0.14)) — nothing in this system needs to look dramatic.
Don't let elevation, motion, or ornament outcompete the garment photography — this system serves the wardrobe, it doesn't perform fashion-magazine density for its own sake.
